name: spec-sync-review-fixes
title: Spec-sync to codebase + review-fix decisions
description: After the origin/main two-axis review: (1) update .trellis/spec/frontend/* to match the current codebase (profile row/menu, single-file profiles.json registry, structPins rename, watcher on every session, integrity selector removal, etc. wherever the spec drifted). (2) Then decide, via one-question-at-a-time grilling, how to address the review findings (standards smells + spec gaps), and implement/verify/commit those fixes.
